facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map, which Grimny revealed is Bral's map to the seven dwarves' hoard from the Dwarven mine.
Grimny says Bral probably hid the hoard in the cave marked "Dragon's lair" on the map; the dwarves had scouted it as a hiding spot and found it empty, unvisited and very small, just one big room.
The dragon reportedly occupying the Dragon's Lair stands between the party and the hoard Bral probably hid there.
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell lets him read the writing under one location on the treasure map per day.
What is the one marked map location still unidentified? Sir Phidipaldi guessed King Hogboon's, but the goblins' temple ruins lay near an unmarked area of the map.
